name: EWS RNA binding protein 1

function.text: EWSR1 encodes RNA-binding protein EWS. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coregulator activity. It participates in regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No established constitutional disease association is assigned after the condition-specific evidence review; disputed or limited relationships are withheld rather than treated as positive findings.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Liposarcoma; Ewing sarcoma; Rhabdomyosarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
